endpoints.name: products_create_price_for_product
endpoints.description: Create Price for a Product The "Create Price for a Product" API allows adding a new price associated with a specific product to the system. sourceId.description: The id of the source of the price from where it is imported

allowOutOfStockPurchases.description: Continue selling when out of stock

sku.description: The unique identifier of the SKU associated with the price

isDigitalProduct.description: Is the product a digital product
